svg.title: Deformable attention computation pipeline with properly subscripted symbols
svg.desc: The query feature z subscript q is linearly projected to 3MK channels which split into K sampling offsets Delta p subscript mqk and K attention weights A subscript mqk. The feature map is bilinearly sampled at the reference point p subscript q plus each offset, then weighted and summed over the K sample points, then combined across M heads with the output projection W subscript m.
